title: 1 year later, widow of Dallas ICE Field Office shooting victim and advocates reflect on attack
summary: A year ago a gunman opened fire at the Dallas ICE Field Office, killing two men in ICE custody and wounding a third. The widow of shooting victim Miguel Angel...
content: A year ago a gunman opened fire at the Dallas ICE Field Office, killing two men in ICE custody and wounding a third. The widow of shooting victim Miguel Angel Garcia-Hernandez is reflecting on what happened – and activists share why they have stepped up efforts to help immigrants as they show up for their check-ins.
